message.content: {"caption":"Two-panel empirical CDF chart comparing evolved-minus-initial skill line-count changes for pass and fail runs in Refine and Repair tasks.","description":"Two side-by-side step plots show ECDF (vertical axis, 0 to 1) against Δ lines (evolved − initial) on a symmetric logarithmic horizontal scale, linear for |Δ| ≤ 50. In both panels, the solid blue line is Opus pass and the dashed red line is Opus fail; dotted vertical lines mark Δ = 0. The left panel, Refine (n = 43), compares pass n = 39 with fail n = 4. The blue pass curve has a long negative tail, with observations extending to roughly −6,000 lines, then rises steeply around zero and reaches 1. The red fail curve is at about 0 until near zero, jumps to about 0.75, and reaches 1 at a moderately positive change. The right panel, Repair (n = 46), compares pass n = 28 with fail n = 18. Both curves have negative tails and rise steeply near zero; the fail curve accumulates earlier at negative changes than the pass curve, while both approach 1 at positive changes.
